title: Ebola Outbreak Spreads as Health Officials Investigate New Cases
subtitle: Authorities are working to track the virus after new deaths are reported in Kenya and a first case is confirmed in Nigeria.

summary.en: Kenya has reported a second death from Ebola as the virus continues to spread across the continent. Health officials are investigating if the first cases in Kenya and Nigeria are connected. Both patients were at a Ugandan airport on the same day in early October. The current outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of Congo in May. Scientists have found that the virus strains in Kenya and Nigeria are very similar.
summary.zh: 肯亞通報了第二起伊波拉死亡病例，該病毒持續在非洲大陸蔓延。衛生官員正在調查肯亞與奈及利亞的首批病例是否互有關聯，兩名患者皆於十月初的同一天出現在烏干達的一座機場。目前的疫情始於五月的剛果民主共和國。科學家已發現肯亞與奈及利亞的病毒株極為相似。

paragraphs.en: Health authorities across Africa are working to control a growing Ebola outbreak that has now reached multiple countries. On Friday, Kenya announced its second death from the virus. The patient was a 65-year-old woman who was a relative of the first person to die from Ebola in Kenya earlier this month. According to Deutsche Welle (DW), the woman had been in quarantine after showing symptoms and received care at a hospital in Nairobi, but she sadly passed away. Seven other people are still receiving treatment for the illness in Kenya.
paragraphs.zh: 非洲各地的衛生當局正致力於控制日益嚴峻的伊波拉病毒疫情，目前疫情已蔓延至多個國家。肯亞於週五宣布出現第二起死亡病例。該名患者為一名六十五歲女性，是本月初肯亞首位伊波拉死者的親屬。根據德國之聲（Deutsche Welle，簡稱 DW）報導，這名女子在出現症狀後便接受隔離，並在奈洛比的一家醫院接受治療，但不幸過世。目前肯亞仍有七人因感染該疾病而接受治療。

paragraphs.en: Ebola is a very serious disease that causes high fever and can be deadly. It spreads through direct contact with the bodily fluids of an infected person or with items that have been contaminated by those fluids. Because there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for the current type of the virus, health officials are focusing on finding and isolating anyone who might have been near a sick person. In Kenya, officials identified 135 people who had contact with the first patient. Of those, 118 were placed in quarantine, and eight have tested positive for the virus so far.
paragraphs.zh: 伊波拉是一種會引發高燒且可能致命的嚴重疾病。它透過直接接觸感染者的體液，或接觸被這些體液污染的物品而傳播。由於目前針對此類病毒尚無核准的疫苗或特效藥，衛生官員正致力於追蹤並隔離所有曾與病患接觸的人員。在肯亞，官員已確認有一百三十五人曾與首位病患接觸，其中一百一十八人已被隔離，目前已有八人檢測結果呈陽性。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, officials are investigating a possible link between the first Ebola cases in Kenya and Nigeria. Nigeria recently confirmed its first case in over ten years. The patient is the wife of a diplomat who had been on vacation in Uganda. According to NPR News, health authorities are looking into whether she and the first Kenyan patient crossed paths at the Entebbe International Airport in Uganda. Both individuals were at the airport on the same day in early October. Dr. Wessam Mankoula from the Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention stated that they are investigating if there was any interaction between the two cases at the airport.
paragraphs.zh: 與此同時，官員正在調查肯亞與奈及利亞首批伊波拉病例之間可能存在的關聯。奈及利亞近期確認了十年來的首起病例，患者為一名曾在烏干達度假的外交官妻子。根據美國國家公共廣播電台（NPR News）報導，衛生當局正在調查她與肯亞首位病患是否曾在烏干達的恩德培國際機場（Entebbe International Airport）有過交集。兩人皆於十月初的同一天出現在該機場。非洲疾病管制暨預防中心（Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention）的曼庫拉醫師（Dr. Wessam Mankoula）表示，他們正在調查這兩起病例在機場期間是否有過互動。

paragraphs.en: Scientific tests are adding weight to the theory that these cases are related. Nigerian Health Minister Muhammad Ali Pate reported that genomic tests show the virus found in the Nigerian patient is highly similar to the one found in the first Kenyan case. While the Swiss Foreign Ministry denied reports that the Nigerian patient had visited the Democratic Republic of Congo, the origin of her infection remains a key focus for investigators. The current outbreak began in the eastern part of the Democratic Republic of Congo in May and has since become the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record.
paragraphs.zh: 科學檢測結果進一步支持了這些病例互有關聯的推論。奈及利亞衛生部長穆罕默德·阿里·佩特（Muhammad Ali Pate）指出，基因組檢測顯示，在奈及利亞患者身上發現的病毒，與肯亞首起病例的病毒高度相似。儘管瑞士外交部否認了關於該名奈及利亞患者曾造訪剛果民主共和國的報導，但其感染源仍是調查人員關注的重點。目前的疫情始於五月剛果民主共和國東部，並已成為有紀錄以來擴散速度最快的伊波拉疫情。

paragraphs.en: As of October 20, World Health Organization figures show that the outbreak has led to more than 9,700 confirmed cases and 4,690 deaths. This situation has caused significant concern among health experts because the virus has now moved far from its starting point. Nigeria is the fourth country to record a case during this outbreak, and it is the furthest west the virus has traveled so far. Despite the spread, Kenyan officials noted that the seven cases currently being treated in their country are all part of one cluster, meaning there is no evidence of wider community spread at this time.
paragraphs.zh: 截至十月二十日，世界衛生組織（World Health Organization）的數據顯示，此次疫情已導致超過九千七百起確診病例，並造成四千六百九十人死亡。由於病毒已遠離最初的爆發點，此情況引起衛生專家的重大擔憂。奈及利亞是此次疫情中第四個出現病例的國家，也是病毒目前向西傳播最遠的地區。儘管疫情擴散，肯亞官員指出，目前該國接受治療的七起病例皆屬於同一群聚感染，這意味著目前尚無證據顯示病毒已在社區廣泛傳播。

paragraphs.en: Public health teams are continuing to trace contacts and manage quarantine efforts to prevent further transmission. In Nigeria, 44 people who had close contact with the patient are currently in quarantine. Medical personnel are working around the clock to provide supportive care to patients and ensure that burials are handled safely and with dignity. As the investigation continues, the focus remains on stopping the movement of the virus and supporting those who are currently sick. International health organizations are monitoring the situation closely, as the lack of a vaccine makes containment the most important tool for saving lives.
paragraphs.zh: 公共衛生團隊持續追蹤接觸者並執行隔離措施，以防止疫情進一步傳播。在奈及利亞，有四十四名曾與病患密切接觸的人員目前正在隔離中。醫療人員正不分晝夜地為病患提供支持性照護，並確保遺體處理過程安全且具尊嚴。隨著調查持續進行，重點仍放在阻斷病毒傳播以及支援現有病患。國際衛生組織正密切監控局勢，由於缺乏疫苗，防疫隔離成為拯救生命最重要的手段。

keyTerms.noteZh: 此片語非字面上的「穿過路徑」，而是指人與人的偶然接觸。文中：According to NPR News, health authorities are looking into whether she and the first Kenyan patient crossed paths at the Entebbe International Airport in Uganda.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To make an idea or theory seem more likely to be true.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 增加某事的可信度、使某理論更有力。
keyTerms.noteZh: 這裡的 weight 指的是證據的份量，而非重量。文中：Scientific tests are adding weight to the theory that these cases are related.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Happening or done continuously, 24 hours a day.
keyTerms.noteZh: 形容工作持續不斷，而非字面上的「繞著時鐘」。文中：Medical personnel are working around the clock to provide supportive care to patients and ensure that burials are handled safely and with dignity.

quiz.question: What is the current status of the Ebola outbreak in Kenya according to the article?

options.A: There have been 135 confirmed deaths across the country.
options.B: Seven people are currently receiving medical treatment for the virus.
options.C: The virus has spread widely throughout the local communities.
options.D: All 118 people in quarantine have tested positive for the virus.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據第一段結尾，文中明確指出「Seven other people are still receiving treatment for the illness in Kenya」。選項 A 錯誤，因為 135 是曾接觸過第一位病患的人數，而非死亡人數。選項 C 錯誤，因為第五段提到官員表示目前沒有證據顯示病毒在社區廣泛傳播。選項 D 錯誤，因為第二段提到在 118 名隔離者中，僅有 8 人檢測呈陽性。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the potential connection between the Kenyan and Nigerian cases?

options.A: The two patients were traveling together on a vacation in Uganda.
options.B: The Nigerian patient likely contracted the virus while visiting a hospital in Nairobi.
options.C: The patients may have been in the same location at the same time in early October.
options.D: Health officials have confirmed that the virus was transmitted directly from the Kenyan patient to the Nigerian patient.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第三段，官員正在調查兩位病患是否在烏干達的恩德培國際機場（Entebbe International Airport）有過交集，因為他們都在十月初的同一天出現在該機場。選項 A 錯誤，文中僅提到奈及利亞病患的丈夫去過烏干達度假。選項 B 錯誤，文中並未提到奈及利亞病患去過奈洛比。選項 D 錯誤，文中僅提到基因測試顯示病毒極為相似，暗示相關性，但並未證實兩者間有直接傳染關係。

quiz.question: In the fourth paragraph, what does the phrase 'adding weight to' mean in the context of the scientific tests?

options.A: Increasing the likelihood that a theory is true.
options.B: Adding physical mass to the evidence collected.
options.C: Making the investigation process more difficult.
options.D: Measuring the exact physical impact of the virus.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。片語「add weight to」在文中意指提供更多證據來支持某個理論或說法，使其更有說服力。選項 B 是字面上的誤解，並非此處的隱喻用法。選項 C 錯誤，科學測試通常是為了釐清真相，而非增加困難。選項 D 錯誤，文中並非在討論病毒的物理重量，而是討論病例之間的關聯性證據。

quiz.question: What is the primary focus of the article?

options.A: To explain the biological symptoms and history of the Ebola virus.
options.B: To criticize the lack of vaccines available in African countries.
options.C: To describe the rapid spread of Ebola and the international efforts to contain it.
options.D: To highlight the specific medical care provided to patients in Nairobi and Nigeria.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。全文主要報導了伊波拉病毒在非洲多國的擴散情況（包含肯亞、奈及利亞與剛果），並強調衛生當局如何透過追蹤接觸者、隔離與調查病例關聯來進行防疫。選項 A 錯誤，文章雖提到症狀，但非重點。選項 B 錯誤，文章提到缺乏疫苗是事實，但並未以此為中心進行批評。選項 D 錯誤，醫療照顧僅是文中提到的一個細節，而非文章的主旨。
